description: Look up a known advisory ID or alias, or an exact ecosystem and package name in the frozen OSV collection. Supply advisory_id OR both ecosystem and package; cursor continues the same lookup. Returns at most 20 concise source matches and route IDs for preview_evidence_answer. Source capture dates and withdrawals are explicit. Full previews include separately dated EPSS/KEV matches and explicit fix boundaries; scores are not asset-risk assessments. No results never mean safe. No range solving, current scanning, independent verification or payment. Free and read-only.
